body.zh-Hant: 1859年9月14日出生於傑爾加瓦縣的利埃塞薩瓦教區。1882年他自傑爾加瓦的庫爾蘭省文科中學畢業，同年入莫斯科大學法學系，1886年畢業。他先任庫爾蘭省檢察署秘書，1888年在傑爾加瓦當律師；1887年成為傑爾加瓦拉脫維亞人協會會長，1889年起擔任《祖國》（Tēvija）週報編輯。
body.en: Čakste was born on 14 September 1859 in Lielsesava parish, Jelgava district. He finished the Courland provincial gymnasium in Jelgava in 1882 and entered the Law Department of Moscow University, graduating in 1886. He served as secretary of the Courland provincial prosecutor's office and in 1888 worked as an advocate in Jelgava. In 1887 he became head of the Jelgava Latvian Society, and from 1889 he edited the weekly Tēvija.

heading.zh-Hant: 歌唱節、國家杜馬與維堡宣言
heading.en: Song festival, the State Duma and the Vyborg Appeal

body.zh-Hant: 1895年他是在傑爾加瓦舉行的第四屆拉脫維亞全國歌唱節的主要組織者之一；1905年參與擬定拉脫維亞自治方案。1906年4月他當選俄國國家杜馬代表，同年7月初沙皇尼古拉二世解散第一屆杜馬後，他與其他民主派代表在芬蘭以維堡宣言抗議，1908年夏被關進傑爾加瓦監獄三個月。
body.en: In 1895 he was one of the main organizers of the Fourth All-Latvian Song Festival in Jelgava, and in 1905 he took part in drafting a Latvian autonomy project. In April 1906 he was elected a deputy to the new Russian State Duma. When Tsar Nicholas II dissolved the First Duma in early July 1906, he joined other democratic deputies in protesting through the Vyborg Appeal in Finland, and in the summer of 1908 he was held in Jelgava prison for three months.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰時難民委員會與人民委員會主席
heading.en: Wartime refugee committee and the People's Council

body.zh-Hant: 1915年他遷往塔爾圖；1917年3月28日在拉脫維亞難民救濟中央委員會主席去世後，他被選為其工作的接續者，同年5月7日又被選為庫爾蘭土地大會主席。1918年11月17日他被一致選為拉脫維亞人民委員會主席。1919年上半年他在巴黎度過；同年11月14日被任命為教授。
body.en: In 1915 he moved to Tartu. On 28 March 1917, after the chairman of the Latvian refugee relief central committee died, he was chosen to continue that work, and on 7 May 1917 he was elected chairman of the Courland Land Congress. On 17 November 1918 he was unanimously elected chairman of the Latvian People's Council. He spent the first half of 1919 in Paris, and on 14 November 1919 he was appointed professor.

heading.zh-Hant: 制憲議會主席與當選國家總統
heading.en: Constituent Assembly chairman and election as State President

body.zh-Hant: 1920年5月1日他以83票當選拉脫維亞第一屆議會——制憲議會——的議長，社會民主黨提名的拉伊尼斯得48票。1922年11月7日憲法通過後舉行首次議會（Saeima）會議，11月14日舉行正式國家總統選舉，他在第二輪以92票當選，6票棄權。
body.en: On 1 May 1920 he was elected chairman of Latvia's first parliament, the Constituent Assembly, with 83 votes, against 48 for the Social Democrats' candidate Rainis. After the adoption of the Constitution the first sitting of the Saeima took place on 7 November 1922, and the State President election was held on 14 November. He was elected in the second round with 92 votes and six abstentions.

body.zh-Hant: 1925年11月6日他在第二輪以60票對卡爾利斯·烏爾馬尼斯的31票再度當選國家總統。他任內簽署公布議會通過的402項法律，赦免549人；任內拉脫維亞政府更替七次。他於1927年3月14日去世，葬於里加的梅薩公墓。
body.en: On 6 November 1925 he was re-elected State President, winning 60 votes to Ulmanis's 31 in the second round. During his presidency he signed and promulgated 402 laws adopted by the Saeima and pardoned 549 people, and Latvia's government changed seven times. He died on 14 March 1927 and was buried at Meža Cemetery in Riga.

text.zh-Hant: 他於1927年3月14日在里加去世，享年67歲。

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與荷屬東印度的軍旅、行政經歷
heading.en: Origins and service in the Dutch East Indies

body.zh-Hant: 科林1869年6月22日生於布爾赫芬（Burgerveen）。1892年12月15日起任東印度軍隊步兵少尉，1901至1903年擔任亞齊總督范赫茨的副官。1907年6月1日起任荷屬東印度政府秘書，到1909年10月1日止。
body.en: Colijn was born on 22 June 1869 in Burgerveen. From 15 December 1892 he was a second lieutenant of infantry in the East Indies Army, and from 1901 to 1903 he was adjutant to J.B. van Heutsz, governor of Aceh. From 1 June 1907 to 1 October 1909 he was secretary of the Netherlands Indies government.

heading.en: Member of the Tweede Kamer and Minister of War

body.zh-Hant: 1909年11月9日至1911年1月4日，科林為斯內克選區的眾議院議員。1911年1月4日他出任戰爭部長，到1913年8月29日止；1912年5月14日起並代理海軍部長至同日。他在任內開始整編陸軍。
body.en: From 9 November 1909 to 4 January 1911 Colijn sat in the Tweede Kamer for the Sneek district. He was Minister of War from 4 January 1911 to 29 August 1913, and from 14 May 1912 he was also acting Minister of the Navy until the same date. In office he began the reorganization of the army.

heading.zh-Hant: 石油業、參議院與反革命黨領袖
heading.en: Oil business, the Eerste Kamer and leadership of the ARP

body.zh-Hant: 1914年3月1日至1920年1月1日他任巴達維亞石油公司（BPM）董事，1914年9月15日至1920年11月10日同時為上議院（代表海爾德蘭省）議員。荷蘭議會資料庫稱他1920年繼凱柏（Kuyper）成為反革命黨（ARP）領袖。1923年8月11日起他出任財政部長。
body.en: From 1 March 1914 to 1 January 1920 he was a director of the Bataafsche Petroleum Maatschappij (BPM), and from 15 September 1914 to 10 November 1920 he also sat in the Eerste Kamer for Gelderland. The Dutch parliamentary database says that in 1920 he succeeded Kuyper as leader of the ARP. From 11 August 1923 he was Minister of Finance.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次內閣與在野期間
heading.en: First cabinet and the years between

body.zh-Hant: 1925年8月4日至1926年3月8日，科林任部長會議主席；Encyclopedia.com的條目稱這第一個內閣只維持了幾個月。其後他於1926年9月23日至1929年8月21日任上議院議員，1929年9月17日至1933年5月26日任眾議院議員；1927年7月14日至1933年5月24日任《旗幟報》（De Standaard）主編。
body.en: From 4 August 1925 to 8 March 1926 Colijn chaired the Council of Ministers; the Encyclopedia.com entry says this first cabinet lasted only a couple of months. He then sat in the Eerste Kamer from 23 September 1926 to 21 August 1929 and in the Tweede Kamer from 17 September 1929 to 26 May 1933, and he was editor-in-chief of De Standaard from 14 July 1927 to 24 May 1933.

heading.en: Prime minister during the economic crisis

body.zh-Hant: 1933年5月26日至1939年8月10日科林再任部長會議主席，並於1933年5月26日至1937年6月24日兼任殖民部長，1937年7月8日起任總務部長。Encyclopedia.com稱他在經濟危機期間主張嚴格緊縮；1934年7月阿姆斯特丹工人區爆發騷亂，1936年9月荷蘭盾被迫貶值，他的政治生涯在1939年8月結束。
body.en: Colijn again chaired the Council of Ministers from 26 May 1933 to 10 August 1939, and was Minister of Colonies from 26 May 1933 to 24 June 1937 and Minister of General Affairs from 8 July 1937. According to Encyclopedia.com he pleaded for severe retrenchment during the crisis; riots broke out in a working-class district of Amsterdam in July 1934, the guilder was devalued in September 1936, and his political career ended in August 1939.

heading.zh-Hant: 德國佔領下的扣留與去世
heading.en: Internment under German occupation and death

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月30日起科林被強制安置在法爾肯堡，同年10月29日起在柏林，1942年3月起在伊爾梅瑙（Ilmenau）。他於1944年9月18日在伊爾梅瑙去世。
body.en: From 30 June 1941 Colijn was held in forced residence at Valkenburg, from 29 October 1941 in Berlin, and from March 1942 at Ilmenau. He died in Ilmenau on 18 September 1944.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、早年工作與加入獨立工黨
heading.en: Origins, early work and the Independent Labour Party

body.zh-Hant: 麥克唐納1866年10月12日生於蘇格蘭的洛西茅斯，是安妮·拉姆齊的私生子。他在當地的董事會學校當過教師，18歲時到布里斯托擔任牧師助理，並在那裡加入社會民主聯盟。1893年他加入獨立工黨，1895年以議員候選人身分參選未果。
body.en: MacDonald was born on 12 October 1866 in Lossiemouth, Scotland, the illegitimate son of Anne Ramsay. He worked as a teacher at the local board school he had attended, moved to Bristol at 18 as a clergyman's assistant, and joined the Social Democratic Federation there. He joined the Independent Labour Party in 1893 and stood unsuccessfully as a parliamentary candidate in 1895.

heading.zh-Hant: 萊斯特議員與工黨議會黨團主席
heading.en: Member for Leicester and chairman of the parliamentary Labour group

body.zh-Hant: 英國議會網站記載麥克唐納自1906年1月12日至1918年12月14日為萊斯特選區議員；Encyclopedia.com稱他在1911至1914年擔任議會工黨主席。他因反對第一次世界大戰而在1918年失去議席。
body.en: MacDonald sat for Leicester from 12 January 1906 to 14 December 1918, according to the UK Parliament's Historic Hansard. Encyclopedia.com says he was chairman of the Parliamentary Labour Party between 1911 and 1914. His opposition to the First World War cost him his seat in 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 返回議會、工黨領袖與首屆工黨政府
heading.en: Return to Parliament, Labour leader and the first Labour government

body.zh-Hant: 1922年11月15日麥克唐納當選阿伯拉文選區議員。Encyclopedia.com稱他不久後即被推為工黨領袖；英國議會網站記載他於1924年1月22日至11月3日任首相；Encyclopedia.com稱他在任內兼理外交。英國政府網站稱，那次選舉期間報紙刊出的「季諾維也夫信」重創了他的反共形象，工黨政府在大選中慘敗。
body.en: MacDonald sat for Aberavon from 15 November 1922. Encyclopedia.com says he was almost immediately voted leader of the Labour Party; Historic Hansard records him as Prime Minister from 22 January to 3 November 1924, and Encyclopedia.com says he acted as foreign secretary in that period. GOV.UK says the 'Zinoviev letter' published during the campaign ruined his anti-Communist credentials and that his Labour administration was heavily defeated.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二屆工黨政府與國民政府
heading.en: Second Labour government and the National Government

body.zh-Hant: 1929年5月30日麥克唐納轉任錫厄姆選區議員，並於1929年6月5日再任首相。英國政府網站稱他任命瑪格麗特·邦德菲爾德為首位女性部長，經濟危機使他把反對黨領袖納入跨黨派的國民政府。Encyclopedia.com稱他因健康不佳於1935年6月7日辭職；英國議會網站則記他任首相至1935年6月6日。
body.en: From 30 May 1929 MacDonald sat for Seaham, and he became Prime Minister again on 5 June 1929. GOV.UK says he appointed Margaret Bondfield as the first female minister and, because of economic crises, brought the opposition leaders into a cross-party national government. Encyclopedia.com says ill health forced him to resign on 7 June 1935, while Historic Hansard gives his premiership as ending on 6 June 1935.

heading.zh-Hant: 蘇格蘭大學議席與逝世
heading.en: Combined Scottish Universities seat and death

body.zh-Hant: 1935年他失去議席，1936年1月31日起代表蘇格蘭聯合大學選區，直到1937年11月9日。英國議會網站另記他自1935年起任樞密院議長至1937年。他於1937年11月9日在前往南美洲的途中去世。
body.en: He lost his seat in the 1935 general election and from 31 January 1936 sat for the Combined Scottish Universities until 9 November 1937. Historic Hansard also lists him as Lord President of the Council from 1935 to 1937. He died on 9 November 1937 on the voyage to South America.
